Do you have great communication skills and want to be a role model to people hoping for a second chance? If you want to make time to help people get their lives back on track, read on.

Who are we?

Community Work and Partnerships We are responsible for the development of mutually beneficial partnerships with government agencies and non-government organisations so that individuals can undertake unpaid work as part of their community-based sentence imposed by the Courts of Victoria. Community work serves as a valuable way for individuals to pay back the community while also reconnecting and reintegrating into the community. We ensure individuals make genuine efforts to undergo rehabilitation, and we keep low risk individuals out of prison and help them contribute to the community.

What does a Field Officer do?

Your primary responsibility as a Field Officer will be to supervise a team of clients at community work sites and other community work programs. A field officer carries out many duties and functions, mainly the supervision of individuals completing community work tasks. Other responsibilities include performing site inspections, assess hazards, providing informed workplace health and safety advice, guidance and instruction; maintaining tools and equipment resister and ensuring repairs are undertaken.

A day in the life of a Field Officer. . .

Your shift starts at a Justice Service Centre location where you collect a bus/ trailer with equipment. You then drive to a site to collect a group of clients, where you will induct, instruct and transport them to a partner not-for-profit organisation in the community. Tasks for the day may involve graffiti removal, painting, litter collection, mowing and weeding. You\'ve been designing long enough to have watched tools become essential and then disappear. You know which design skills are timeless and which ones expire.Â\xa0The human-centered design skills are where your heart is, and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

You can name theÂ\xa0ten leading designersÂ\xa0who should be teaching the worldâ\x80\x99s best courses and Master Classes right now. You know what each of them does better than anyone else, and where their gaps are.

Now you get the opportunity to decide what hundreds of thousands of designers learn next.

The industry leaders whose expertise you\'ll be turning into courses and Master Classes includeÂ\xa0Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads atÂ\xa0Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe. Don Norman also chairs our executive board.

You\'ll be involved in the entire process of creating our courses and Master Classes, and you\'ll lead many of the decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you toÂ\xa0take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. Youâ\x80\x99ll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

IxDF is the world\'s largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us take online education to new heightsÂ\xa0andÂ\xa0make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, weâ\x80\x99re not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We\'ve pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We\'re Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We\'re growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here\'s what each role leads on:

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI: lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what\'s missing, what doesn\'t belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.Â\xa0This is the role described here.

  • Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI: lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

  • Our Course Writers and Editors: lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâ\x80\x99s perspective.

We\'re a flexible team, and you\'ll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you\'re torn between two roles, apply for the one you\'d be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Director, decide what belongs in our curriculum and who should teach it. You reach out to the worldâ\x80\x99s leading experts, plan the courses with them, and shoot courses with them. When an Education Designer brings you a course outline, you\'re the one who says what\'s missing, what doesn\'t belong, and how to optimize the learning outcome so designers can succeed today. You\'ll work closely with ourÂ\xa0Co-Founder, yourÂ\xa0Team Lead, our otherÂ\xa0Course Directors, and theÂ\xa0Education Designers, and you\'ll plan and create courses alongside them. Our Course Writers and Editors take the finished material the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You\'ll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team. You\'ll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You\'ll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

  • You\'ll research what already exists in a topic area, so that what we build is genuinely unique. You\'ll look atÂ\xa0where design and AI are heading, what designers needÂ\xa0that nobody has taught well yet, andÂ\xa0what we should retireÂ\xa0because the field has already moved on.

  • Find the people who should teach it.Â\xa0You decide a topic is worth a course, you work out who should teach it and why, you write the email, and you get the yes. Then you plan the content with the industry leader and agree what the course must leave a learner able to do.

  • Decide what each expert should teach.Â\xa0The best designers know a great deal, and a course that tries to capture all of it becomes an information dump. You develop a point of view on what a designer genuinely needs from them, and you hold the course to it.

  • You\'ll decide which skills our courses teach, both to people entering design and to experienced designers leveling up. Our goal is to help designers thrive in the age of AI and work responsibly, so their users can thrive too.

  • Ensure our course participants finish each course with a solid portfolio project they can show a hiring manager.

  • Help us decide what AI should do for our course participants. Personalized learning paths, constructive AI feedback on portfolio work, practice environments where people run real design tasks and get feedback. You\'ll also help us improve the user flows on our own platform, so that learning at IxDF is as well designed as what we teach. You\'ll work on this with our founders, designers, and dev team.

  • Make an impact as you pressure-test the coursesÂ\xa0our Education Designers plan. An Education Designer sends you a course outline, and you read it against everything you know about the field and about how people learn design, then give constructive feedback on what\'s missing, what doesn\'t belong, and where the structure can be improved.Â\xa0You know the limits of your own expertise, and you research your way past them before you weigh in. You\'ll also plan, structure, and create courses yourself, alongside them.

  • You\'re one of the peopleÂ\xa0whose judgment the rest of the team leans on.Â\xa0You show our Education Designers what ten or twenty years in the field taught you to look for. In return, our Co-Founder, your Team Lead, and our other Course Directors give constructive feedback on the courses you lead. You\'ll work in aÂ\xa0diverse, highly organized, result-driven environmentÂ\xa0where you\'ll grow personally and professionally.

  • Act as guardian of our quality bar. When a course goes out under our name, it has to be better than anything else available on the topic. On the courses and Master Classes you lead or review, you\'re the one who spots what\'s not good enough yet and works with the team to fix it.

  • Bring your subject matter expertiseÂ\xa0to our writers, community managers, and social media team, so our design thinking stays consistent across everything we publish.

  • You help produce Master Classes. We produce 3 per month. Over email, you reach out to designers whose work you admire, invite them to create one with us, plan the content, and produce the live session.Â\xa0Timelines vary enormously:Â\xa0with Don Norman or Vitaly Friedman it can be two weeks from first email to publication, because we work with them often. With a new expert, it can be half a year. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Education Designers and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go.

  • Focus on what mattersÂ\xa0as you take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design. You\'ll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI.

  • Design for a diverse, global audience.Â\xa0Some of our courses and Master Classes serve working designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields. Often, a course will serve both in the same lesson. Getting both right without watering either down is a rewarding design challenge.

  • Give the video teamÂ\xa0constructive feedbackÂ\xa0on course and Master Class videos, from on-screen text and b-roll to graphics and animation, so each video is engaging to learn from and accurate from a design perspective.

  • Fly out and meet the global industry leaders in design in professional studios across the world.Â\xa0You\'ll shoot the course content there with some of your colleagues. Expect this a few times a year at minimum. Some of us love that part and join every studio production; others keep it to those few trips. Both work for us. On averageÂ\xa0we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.

  • Expect to have several courses moving at once at different stages: one you\'re planning with an expert, one being shot, one in production, and one published course that you\'re reviewing and improving.

  • Find room for improvementÂ\xa0by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios course participants produce, then go back and fix what isn\'t excellent yet. Use the power of incremental, modular design as you help push the quality of our educational materials to new heights, surpassing even the very best in industry and academia. We\'re always learning, always improving, always raising the bar in everything we do and ship.

  • Maintain and improve our crystal-clear documentationÂ\xa0so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

  • We\'re proud to have assembledÂ\xa0a remarkable team of unicornsÂ\xa0who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There\'s a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

About You

  • You have at leastÂ\xa010 years of hands-on design experience. Thirty is not too many.

  • You have aÂ\xa0network among designers you respect, and you\'reÂ\xa0comfortable writing to someone you admireÂ\xa0and presenting them with an opportunity.

  • You know what the design community wants to see, and what it needs to learn.

  • You\'re kind, and you have theÂ\xa0social intelligence and empathy toÂ\xa0engage well with very different kinds of people. Much of this job is convincing busy, accomplished people that what we\'re building is worth their time.

  • You can show us something you built or led: a product, a design team, a course, an AI teaching app, or a conference track. We\'re excited to hear what it was, your thinking behind it, how long it took you to create, what went wrong, and how you improved it.

  • You can take aÂ\xa0broad, complex design practice and turn it into a step-by-step learning sequenceÂ\xa0that\'ll make a beginner feel and act confident. You can look at a plan for teaching something andÂ\xa0see what\'s missingÂ\xa0before anyone builds it.
